target.title: feat(skills): preview proposals before approval
target.body:
Closes #103871

## Summary

- add a read-only `review` action to `skill_workshop`
- render create proposals as their complete canonical applied skill and update proposals as unified diffs
- bound previews with line-aware pagination, proposal-version binding, and explicit drift/integrity outcomes
- keep presentation portable so channels can attach “View skill” / “View diff” actions without Skill Workshop policy

## What Problem This Solves

Approval messages currently provide only a prose summary. Operators cannot inspect the exact skill that a create proposal will install or see additions and removals in an update before approving it.

## Why This Change Was Made

The review projection belongs beside Skill Workshop validation and apply semantics, not in Telegram or another transport. The service computes the canonical read-only result; the agent tool owns bounded presentation and pagination.

## User Impact

Existing Proposal-ID-only lifecycle flows remain compatible. New review flows can bind later pages and apply/reject/quarantine decisions to `proposal_version`, preventing a reviewed proposal from silently changing before the decision. Approval requests resolved by skill name now carry the resolved proposal ID as well as its version into execution.

## Evidence

- 239 focused Vitest tests pass on the final rebased commit.
- Production and test tsgo checks pass.
- Exact-file oxlint/oxfmt, docs formatting, and `git diff --check` pass.
- Fresh structured autoreview found and prompted one approval-parameter fix; review of both that fix and the final 115,842-character branch bundle then reported no accepted/actionable findings.
- A redacted, inspectable live Telegram recording covers create/update review, pagination, first-page lifecycle controls, approval/rejection, and stale-version rejection. The direct artifact link is in **Real behavior proof** below.
- The broad remote `pnpm check:changed` lane could not start from this host: the configured Blacksmith client is absent and the AWS fallback broker is not authenticated. GitHub CI remains the broad remote gate.

## Verification

```bash
OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts \
  src/agents/tools/skill-workshop-tool.test.ts \
  src/agents/tool-mutation.test.ts \
  src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts \
  src/agents/agent-tools.before-tool-call.embedded-mode.test.ts

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental \
  --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental \
  --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo

node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs $(git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD -- '*.ts')
pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/skills/workshop/policy.ts src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts
pnpm format:docs:check
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main
```

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: preview the exact canonical result of a Skill Workshop proposal before approval and bind the later lifecycle decision to that reviewed version.
Real environment tested: live Telegram DM on the deployed production-patched OpenClaw runtime at `ef2acbbe69b52f92c788188de3b159de92ad24ef`; all 19 files touched by PR head `87a5fbc3b42da0d1e7322a34bcf038e9451b2607` are byte-identical in that runtime.
Exact steps or command run after this patch: review a paginated create proposal and its first-page Approve/Reject/Next controls; revise v1 to v2 and attempt approval from the stale v1 prompt; review and approve the fresh v2 prompt; review an update proposal's unified diff and reject it.
Evidence after fix: [redacted H.264 Telegram recording](https://f005.backblazeb2.com/file/Hetzner-Openclaw/pr-artifacts/openclaw-103872/87a5fbc3/1691a798/pr-103872-telegram-proof.mp4?Authorization=3_20260711090657_c2ed04244ad7b5248a3e644a_2539c27da42238cee21c9519b915add2b4ae651b_005_20260718090657_0075_dnld) (71.37 seconds, 4,480,020 bytes, SHA-256 `1691a798025c9ffa45bd8ffd6b91980079dcf23d069bdc5b598adb6f93727da5`; temporary public link valid through 2026-07-18 09:06 UTC). Timeline: 00:00 create preview/pagination, 00:23 stale-v1 rejection, 00:36 fresh-v2 review/approval, 00:50 update diff/rejection.
Observed result after fix: create approval succeeds only for the reviewed current version; stale approval fails closed with expected-v1/current-v2 feedback; update review shows the unified diff; Approve and Reject remain available from page 1.
What was not tested: a separate burner-account Crabbox run or a runtime whose overall Git commit exactly equals the PR head; the live runtime instead uses a production integration commit whose complete PR-touched source is byte-identical to the final head.

## AI assistance

AI-assisted: yes. Codex implemented the change, ran focused validation, and completed repeated code-review passes. No agent transcript is attached.
